name: zclass_cls_di_snap_probe_point_y_to_best_candidate
description: zClass_cls_di::SnapProbePointYToBestCandidate builds below-point candidates from the runtime DI scene, selects a probe sample height with Player's candidate selector, writes the selected Y back to the point, and returns the candidate-list build status.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass_cls_di/Player probe source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42ba50 validates the fastcall point argument, the g_Player_RuntimeDiScene candidate-list call using point->x, constant max Y 500.0, and point->z, then the Player::SelectProbeSampleHeightFromCandidates call with point->y, maxRiseWindow 2.0, preferAttachmentSlot1 0, and stack output slots.
The native smoke verifies a candidate path snaps point->y to the selected hit height and a no-candidate path returns the build status while preserving the original sample height.
